At Push Security, we measure this as breakthrough rate: The share of attacks that get past email security, web gateways, and safe browsing to reach the user.
control_implications.headline: Phishing kits bypass email security web filtering and safe browsing
control_implications.significance: Measured breakthrough rates showing phishing kits evading layered defenses weaken detection coverage assurance. Detection and monitoring owners should confirm whether telemetry distinguishes breakthrough attacks from expected traffic and review alert routing for high-breakthrough kits.

paragraphs.text: Active exploitation of highly critical vulnerabilities in Drupal core and GeoServer, alongside CISA's addition of ten flaws to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog including Mitel MiCollab, signals an elevated tempo of weaponized vulnerability exploitation against widely deployed platforms. Control owners must verify that asset inventories capture affected products and that remediation or compensating controls are validated with version evidence.

Simultaneous identity-focused campaigns — including the GoodGuys phishing operation harvesting corporate Google and Okta credentials, North Korea-linked PolinRider poisoning over 7,600 GitHub repositories, and the 1Password backend breach exposing customer information — extend risk beyond perimeter defenses into trusted software supply chains and identity providers. Access management and third-party risk owners should confirm authentication coverage against brand-impersonation lures and review supplier dependencies on compromised repositories.
